PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-0421 triggered: routing-service high error-rate (P1) — pages sent to @Maria Chen

Maria Chen: I'm on it, waking up. seeing errors from routing-service v2.3.1, impact on some hosted customers.

Ajay Patel: What symptoms? 5xxs or latency? any region pattern?

Maria Chen: 5xx spikes and timeouts. Telemetry shows repeated failover hops across regions: us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east. latency spikes ~800ms on avg during flips.

Lee Gomez: Who pushed routing policy changes last 30m? I see an automated policy rollout at 11:58 UTC.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout "smart-fallback:v1.4" applied to routing-service at 2026-03-15T11:58:12Z by ci-cd.

Maria Chen: Copy. dumping the applied policy config now.

Maria Chen: ```yaml
routing_policy: smart-fallback
primary_region: us-east
fallbacks: [us-west, eu]
healthcheck: {interval: 10s, consecutive_failures: 2}
debounce_window: 0s  # note: zero debounce
circuit_breaker: {error_threshold: 0.05, window: 60s}
```

Ajay Patel: debounce_window=0s stands out. If health probes are noisy we'll flip instantly.

Lee Gomez: check probe logs, I'm seeing probes mark us-east unhealthy, then us-west, then eu, ~4s apart.

Maria Chen: logs: ```
[2026-03-15T11:59:02Z] probe/us-east: fail (timeout)
[2026-03-15T11:59:06Z] routing: failover -> us-west
[2026-03-15T11:59:07Z] probe/us-west: fail (5xx)
[2026-03-15T11:59:09Z] routing: failover -> eu
[2026-03-15T11:59:10Z] probe/eu: success
[2026-03-15T11:59:12Z] routing: failback -> us-east
```

Maria Chen: that's a clear flipflop. Customers in EU and APAC report intermittent failures.

SRE Rotation: paging: Maria -> Ajay for backup.

Ajay Patel: Oncall handoff acknowledged. quick mitigation idea: disable automatic multi-hop fallback, pin traffic to primary region and increase debounce to 30s.

Lee Gomez: Agreed. Also consider temporarily raising consecutive_failures to 4 so probes are less sensitive.

Maria Chen: I'm going to set a hotfix to policy: set debounce_window=30s and consecutive_failures=4, and push a soft-circuit-breaker to avoid immediate multi-hop.

Ajay Patel: If we change policy via control plane, we can do it without full deploy. Maria, do you have the control-plane command?

Maria Chen: yes. running:```bash
redwoodctl policy set routing-service smart-fallback --set debounce_window=30s --set healthcheck.consecutive_failures=4 --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: control-plane: policy update requested by Maria Chen. applying...

Maria Chen: applied. verifying...

Maria Chen: verification logs show: ```
routing_policy updated: debounce_window=30s, consecutive_failures=4 at 2026-03-15T12:03:21Z
```

Lee Gomez: Start of stabilization visible: probe events decreased, routing stays on us-east for ~40s now instead of 4s.

Ajay Patel: Good. Can we add a temporary guard to prevent choosing a fallback region if the primary health signal was a single probe failure in last 60s?

Maria Chen: I added a short-lived rule: min_primary_success_window=60s. applied.

Maria Chen: customer impact summary — partial outages for a subset of sessions in EU and APAC between 11:59–12:03 UTC, elevated 5xx rate ~7% for affected tenants, incidents routed to support.

SRE Rotation: escalation done. notifying support/ops for postmortem.

Lee Gomez: Root cause hypothesis: new smart-fallback rollout had debounce=0s and aggressive failover logic. Combined with transient probe latency (maybe GC or infra noise) produced a three-way failover loop.

Ajay Patel: Action items: 1) rollback smart-fallback defaults to safe values in config repo (debounce >= 30s, failures >= 3) 2) add canary gating to control-plane updates that modify debounce or failover order 3) add synthetic probe smoothing on short timescales 4) postmortem and customer comms.

Maria Chen: Filing a rollback PR now and will follow up with a postmortem draft. PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/988 - description: "safe-defaults for fallback policy; add canary-expiration"

ops-bot: ticket created: INC-2026-0421 (owner: Maria Chen) — linked PR 988.

Maria Chen: paging cleared. monitoring for 30m. please ack if you see any re-flap. :thumbsup:

Ajay Patel: ACK. I'll schedule a quick post-incident review at 16:00 UTC.

Lee Gomez: I'll scrub telemetry and provide a timeline + graphs for the postmortem.

PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status: acknowledged -> resolved (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T12:07:37Z (page duration ~8m)

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Follow-up notes: disable auto-apply of extreme policy changes without canary in control-plane; improve docs for debounce parameter.

SRE Rotation: closing thread in 30m unless new alerts appear.
